trials.issue: Rear belt holders pierced the ranger vest in the rest view; minimum common-ray gap was about -19mm.
trials.correction: Constrain waist and belt under the actual ranger top v4 sections.

trials.issue: Triangles crossing the sloping vest hem still protruded between corrected vertices; minimum rest waist gap about -13mm.
trials.correction: Include triangle centers and edge midpoints in the overlap correction.

trials.issue: Per-vertex corrections folded the lower rear holder ends.
trials.correction: Translate each detached accessory component inward rigidly while allowing the main trousers to deform.

trials.issue: Raised legs contaminated outer waist rays when all trouser faces were measured; apparent error exceeded 0.4m.
trials.correction: Measure faces entirely above rest Y=1.0m, retaining waist and belt accessories. Do not interpret knee intersections as waist failure.

retention: Keep original source, final candidate and review files; intermediate GLBs and Blender variants were not stored.
